high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of a Twitter conversation. The top part of the image shows a tweet from a user who praises another user named Zubin for taking great pictures. The user suggests that the road shown in the picture will be great to drive on but expresses a desire to find a device that can extend over and under the bridge to observe the fauna passing underneath. Below this tweet, there is a reply from Zubin Ashara (@zubinash...), who posted an image of a 16 km long elevated highway located in Pench Tiger Reserve, India.
